subject.title: feat: version field in health response + POST /admin/update endpoint

question: Should OpenClaw expose update execution over a gateway-authenticated HTTP surface for fleet tools, and if so should it be a dedicated `/admin/update` contract or an allowlisted Admin HTTP RPC wrapper around `update.run`?
rationale: The requested update endpoint would give network callers host package-update and restart authority, while current docs treat Admin HTTP RPC as a full trusted operator surface and current code intentionally omits `update.run` from that allowlist.

options.title: Split and defer HTTP update authority
options.body: Keep version metadata in the narrower tracker and require a maintainer-owned security/API design before exposing update execution over HTTP.

options.title: Expose a trusted admin update surface
options.body: Allow a dedicated endpoint or `update.run` wrapper only with explicit private-ingress, auth, audit, rate-limit, target-version, failure-mode, and upgrade-proof requirements.

options.title: Reject HTTP update execution
options.body: Keep update execution limited to existing CLI/WebSocket/control-plane surfaces and document that fleet tools should use those or an external orchestrator.

recommendation.title: Split and defer HTTP update authority
recommendation.body: Keep version metadata in the narrower tracker and require a maintainer-owned security/API design before exposing update execution over HTTP.

likelyOwner.reason: This owner has the strongest combined history across Admin HTTP RPC, update restart flow, and adjacent version resolver work.
